messages:
Ava G: Quick sync — proposing a combined design review for the new API+SDK+Console UX flows. TL;DR: single 60m session to align contracts, SDK ergonomics, and console screens. Proposed pre-read + checklist below. Can folks pick a preferred slot?

Ravi K: +1. prefer mornings. I'm out Wed afternoon.

Priya S: +1. Can we make sure SDK owners are looped (cc @Tom L)? Also need migration plan doc.

Tom L: thanks — SDK team prefers Tue/Thu 10-11am PT. Thu works best for me.

Ava G: options: Tue 2026-04-21 10:00 PT, Thu 2026-04-23 10:00 PT, Fri 2026-04-24 09:00 PT. Vote with emoji or reply w/ conflicts.

Ravi K: Thu 👍

Priya S: Tue :+1: if we can shift to 9:30. tight but ok.

Tom L: Thu still best for SDK.

Ava G: OK leaning Thu. Pre-read checklist (please upload to the drive folder linked):
- API: OpenAPI contract (paths, request/response examples)
- SDK: high-level surface, sync/async patterns, migration notes
- Console: three wireframes + acceptance criteria
- Performance: latency SLOs, typical payload sizes
- Backwards compat risks + fallback strategy
- PRs: link code review numbers
Link: https://drive.re/redwood/designs/new-feature-pre-read

Priya S: I'll drop the migration doc and sample code (PR #4578)

Tom L: I'll add SDK surface doc and a short ergonomics note.

deploy-bot: calendar event proposal sent for Thu 2026-04-23 10:00 PT — attendees: Ava G, Ravi K, Priya S, Tom L, infra-oncall.

Ava G: Agenda (60m): 1) 5m intro + goals 2) 20m API contract walkthrough 3) 15m SDK ergonomics + migration 4) 15m Console UX + acceptance 5) 5m next steps/owners

Ravi K: Can we reserve 15m at the end for perf implications and rollout plan? feels tight.

Ava G: Good call — shift to agenda: 1) 5m intro 2) 18m API 3) 12m SDK 4) 18m Console 5) 7m perf/rollout

Tom L: noted. Will bring quick numbers on integration testing.

Priya S: If anyone has blockers on the pre-read, pls flag within 48h. Otherwise we'll expect everyone to skim.

Ava G: FYI, please add any open items to the doc under 'parking lot'. Also assign owners for follow-ups before the meeting.

Ravi K: I'll own rollout checklist.

Tom L: SDK migration owner: me.

Priya S: Console acceptance owner: Priya.

Ava G: thanks. ping me if you can't make Thu and we'll find a fallback or record it.

Priya S: small nit — can we include a short demo/video clip of the current Console flow to illustrate pain points?

Ava G: yes, drop MP4 in the folder or a Loom link.

infra-oncall: FYI — we'll need to pre-provision a test cluster for the canary; requesting 48h lead time.

Ava G: noted; infra-oncall, can you create a ticket and tag infra-team? we'll track in the doc.

infra-oncall: created ticket INF-8921 and linked it in the pre-read folder.

Ava G: perfect. last ask: if you have any hard constraints (vacation, comp off) pls add to thread. otherwise see you Thu 10:00 PT :calendar:
